    Membership = "membership",

    readonly item: T;

    removeAt(index: number): void;
    delete(key: TKey): boolean;

    setAt(index: number, newItem: TItem): void;

    move(fromIndex: number, toIndex: number): void;
    clear(): void;
    upsert(item: TItem): boolean;
}

declare enum AsyncResourceStatus {
    Idle = "Idle",
    Loading = "Loading",
    Ready = "Ready",
    Error = "Error"
}
declare enum AsyncResourceRetention {
    DiscardPrevious = "DiscardPrevious",
    RetainPrevious = "RetainPrevious"
}
type AsyncResourceState<T> = Readonly<{
    status: AsyncResourceStatus.Idle;
}> | Readonly<{
    status: AsyncResourceStatus.Loading;
    value?: T;
}> | Readonly<{
    status: AsyncResourceStatus.Ready;
    value: T;
}> | Readonly<{
    status: AsyncResourceStatus.Error;
    error: unknown;
    value?: T;
}>;

    readonly name: string;
    readonly loader: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>;
    readonly hub: IMessageHub;
    readonly dispatcher: IDispatcher;
    readonly hint?: string;
    readonly retention?: AsyncResourceRetention;
    readonly cleanupValue?: (value: T) => void;
}

    readonly reloadCommand: AsyncRelayCommand;
    readonly cancelCommand: RelayCommand;

    get state(): AsyncResourceState<T>;

    reload(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;

    protected _onDispose(): void;
}

    children(factory: () => Iterable<VM>): GroupVMBuilder<VM>;
    onConstruct(cb: () => void): GroupVMBuilder<VM>;
    onDestruct(cb: () => void): GroupVMBuilder<VM>;
    build(): GroupVM<VM>;
}

interface HierarchicalVMOptions<TModel, TVM> {
    model: TModel;
    childrenFactory: (parent: TVM) => Iterable<TVM>;
    hub?: IMessageHub;
    dispatcher?: IDispatcher;
    name?: string;
    hint?: string;
    eagerChildren?: boolean;
}
declare enum MissingParentPolicy {
    Park = "park",
    Reject = "reject"
}
declare enum BatchAttachRejectionReason {
    DuplicateExistingKey = "duplicate_existing_key",
    DuplicateBatchKey = "duplicate_batch_key",
    AlreadyAttached = "already_attached",
    MissingParent = "missing_parent",
    Cycle = "cycle",
    SelectorFailed = "selector_failed",
    AttachmentFailed = "attachment_failed"
}
interface BatchAttachOptions<TVM, TKey> {
    keyOf: (item: TVM) => TKey;
    parentKeyOf: (item: TVM) => TKey | null;
    onMissingParent?: MissingParentPolicy;
}
interface BatchAttachRejection<TVM> {
    item: TVM;
    reason: BatchAttachRejectionReason;
    detail?: string;
}
interface BatchAttachResult<TVM> {
    added: readonly TVM[];
    duplicates: readonly TVM[];
    orphans: readonly TVM[];
    rejections: readonly BatchAttachRejection<TVM>[];
}
declare abstract class HierarchicalVM<TModel, TVM extends HierarchicalVM<TModel, TVM>> extends ComponentVMBase {
    #private;
    constructor(opts: HierarchicalVMOptions<TModel, TVM> & {
        hub: IMessageHub;
        dispatcher: IDispatcher;
    });
    constructor(opts: HierarchicalVMOptions<TModel, TVM>);
    get type(): ViewModelType;
    get model(): TModel;
    get parent(): TVM | null;
    get isRoot(): boolean;
    get depth(): number;
    get isLeaf(): boolean;
    get isFirst(): boolean;
    get isLast(): boolean;
    get children(): readonly TVM[];
    get path(): readonly TVM[];
    [Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<TVM>;
    protected _onConstruct(): void;
    addChild(child: TVM): void;
    removeChild(child: TVM): void;
    reparentChild(child: TVM): void;
    get parkedAttachCount(): number;
    attachMany<TKey>(items: Iterable<TVM>, options: BatchAttachOptions<TVM, TKey>): BatchAttachResult<TVM>;
    invalidateChildren(): void;
    invalidateSubtree(): void;
    protected _onDispose(): void;
}
type HierarchicalVMConstructionContext<TModel, TVM> = HierarchicalVMOptions<TModel, TVM> & {
    hub: IMessageHub;
    dispatcher: IDispatcher;
};
declare class HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM extends HierarchicalVM<TModel, TVM>> {
    #private;
    constructor(from?: HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>);
    model(value: TModel): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    childrenFactory(fn: (parent: TVM) => Iterable<TVM>): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    services(hub: IMessageHub, dispatcher: IDispatcher): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    name(value: string): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    hint(value: string): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    eagerChildren(value: boolean): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    vmFactory(fn: (ctx: HierarchicalVMConstructionContext<TModel, TVM>) => TVM): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    withDefaultServices(): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    build(): TVM;
}

declare class DerivedProperty<TValue> {
    #private;
    constructor(derivedStream: Observable<TValue>, canSet?: ((v: TValue) => boolean) | null, setAction?: ((v: TValue) => void) | null);
    get value(): TValue;
    get valueChanged(): Observable<TValue>;
    canSet(value: TValue): boolean;
    setValue(value: TValue): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
interface DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue> {
    canSet?: (value: TValue) => boolean;
    setAction?: (value: TValue) => void;
}
declare function fromOne<T1, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, transform: (v1: T1) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
declare function fromTwo<T1, T2, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, s2: Observable<T2>, transform: (v1: T1, v2: T2) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
declare function fromThree<T1, T2, T3, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, s2: Observable<T2>, s3: Observable<T3>, transform: (v1: T1, v2: T2, v3: T3) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
declare function fromFour<T1, T2, T3, T4, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, s2: Observable<T2>, s3: Observable<T3>, s4: Observable<T4>, transform: (v1: T1, v2: T2, v3: T3, v4: T4) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
declare function fromFive<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, s2: Observable<T2>, s3: Observable<T3>, s4: Observable<T4>, s5: Observable<T5>, transform: (v1: T1, v2: T2, v3: T3, v4: T4, v5: T5) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
declare function fromSources<TValue>(sources: Observable<unknown>[], transform: (...values: unknown[]) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
declare const fromMany: typeof fromSources;

declare const CAPABILITIES: unique symbol;
type CapabilityName = "ISelectable" | "IDeselectable" | "ISelectionTogglable" | "IExpandable" | "ICollapsible" | "IExpansionTogglable" | "IConstructable" | "IDestructable" | "IReconstructable" | "IClosable" | "IApprovable" | "ICancelable" | "ISearchable" | "INewCreatable" | "IDeletable" | "IUpdatable" | "ISavable" | "ICurrentDeletable" | "ICurrentUpdatable" | "IManagable" | "IFilterable" | "IPageable";
declare function declareCapabilities(obj: object, ...caps: CapabilityName[]): void;
declare function hasCapability(obj: unknown, cap: CapabilityName): boolean;

// ==== messageHub.d.ts ====
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

interface IMessage {
    readonly senderName: string;
    readonly sender: unknown;
}
interface ITypedMessage<TSender> extends IMessage {
    readonly sender: TSender;
}


interface IMessageHub {
    readonly messages: Observable<IMessage>;
    send(message: IMessage): void;
}
interface ITransactionalMessageHub extends IMessageHub {
    batch(transaction: () => void): void;
}
interface MessageHubOptions {
    readonly developmentDiagnostics?: boolean;
}
declare class MessageHub implements ITransactionalMessageHub {
    #private;
    constructor(options?: MessageHubOptions);
    get messages(): Observable<IMessage>;
    send(message: IMessage): void;
    batch(transaction: () => void): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

export { type IMessage as I, MessageHub as M, type IMessageHub as a, type ITransactionalMessageHub as b, type ITypedMessage as c, type MessageHubOptions as d };

// ==== notifications.d.ts ====
import { Observable, SchedulerLike } from 'rxjs';
import { R as RelayCommand } from './relayCommand.js';

declare enum NotificationType {
    Error = "Error",
    Notification = "Notification",
    Confirmation = "Confirmation"
}
declare enum NotificationReaction {
    Pending = "Pending",
    Approve = "Approve",
    Reject = "Reject"
}
declare class Notification {
    readonly type: NotificationType;
    readonly message: string;
    constructor(type: NotificationType, message: string);
}


interface INotificationHub {
    readonly pending: Observable<readonly Notification[]>;
    post(notification: Notification): Promise<NotificationReaction>;
    resolve(notification: Notification, reaction: NotificationReaction): void;
}
declare class NotificationHub implements INotificationHub {
    #private;
    get pending(): Observable<readonly Notification[]>;
    post(notification: Notification): Promise<NotificationReaction>;
    resolve(notification: Notification, reaction: NotificationReaction): void;
    dispose(): void;
}


declare class NullNotificationHub implements INotificationHub {
    static readonly INSTANCE: NullNotificationHub;
    private constructor();
    readonly pending: Observable<readonly Notification[]>;
    post(_notification: Notification): Promise<NotificationReaction>;
    resolve(_notification: Notification, _reaction: NotificationReaction): void;
}

declare function makeConfirm(hub: INotificationHub, prompt: string): () => Promise<boolean>;


declare class NotificationVM {
    #private;
    readonly dismissCommand: RelayCommand;
    constructor(notification: Notification, hub: INotificationHub, scheduler: SchedulerLike, lifespanMs?: number, tickIntervalMs?: number);
    get notification(): Notification;
    get propertyChanged(): Observable<string>;
    get lifespanMs(): number;
    get remainingMs(): number;
    get opacity(): number;
    get isResolved(): boolean;
    dispose(): void;
    protected armsExpiryTimer(): boolean;
    protected onExpire(): void;
    protected dismiss(): void;
    protected resolveWith(reaction: NotificationReaction): void;
}


declare class ConfirmationVM extends NotificationVM {
    #private;
    readonly approveCommand: RelayCommand;
    readonly rejectCommand: RelayCommand;
    constructor(notification: Notification, hub: INotificationHub, scheduler: SchedulerLike, lifespanMs?: number, tickIntervalMs?: number);
    protected armsExpiryTimer(): boolean;
    protected onExpire(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

export { ConfirmationVM, type INotificationHub, Notification, NotificationHub, NotificationReaction, NotificationType, NotificationVM, NullNotificationHub, makeConfirm };

// ==== relayCommand.d.ts ====
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';


interface ICommand {
    canExecute(): boolean;
    execute(): void;
    readonly canExecuteChanged: Observable<void>;
}
interface ICommandOf<T> {
    canExecute(parameter: T): boolean;
    execute(parameter: T): void;
    readonly canExecuteChanged: Observable<void>;
}
interface IAsyncCommand extends ICommand {
    readonly isExecuting: boolean;
    executeAsync(externalSignal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;
    cancel(): void;
}

declare class RelayCommand implements ICommand {
    #private;
    constructor(task: (() => void) | null, predicate: (() => boolean) | null, triggers: Observable<unknown>[]);
    canExecute(): boolean;
    execute(): void;
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    dispose(): void;
    static builder(): RelayCommandBuilder;
}
declare class RelayCommandBuilder {
    #private;
    constructor(task: (() => void) | null, predicate: (() => boolean) | null, triggers: readonly Observable<unknown>[]);
    task(fn: () => void): RelayCommandBuilder;
    predicate(fn: () => boolean): RelayCommandBuilder;
    triggers(obs: Observable<unknown>): RelayCommandBuilder;
    build(): RelayCommand;
}
declare class RelayCommandOf<T> implements ICommandOf<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(task: ((p: T) => void) | null, predicate: ((p: T) => boolean) | null, triggers: Observable<unknown>[]);
    canExecute(parameter: T): boolean;
    execute(parameter: T): void;
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    dispose(): void;
    static builder<T>(): RelayCommandOfBuilder<T>;
}
declare class RelayCommandOfBuilder<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(task: ((p: T) => void) | null, predicate: ((p: T) => boolean) | null, triggers: readonly Observable<unknown>[]);
    task(fn: (p: T) => void): RelayCommandOfBuilder<T>;
    predicate(fn: (p: T) => boolean): RelayCommandOfBuilder<T>;
    triggers(obs: Observable<unknown>): RelayCommandOfBuilder<T>;
    build(): RelayCommandOf<T>;
}

export { type ICommand as I, RelayCommand as R, type IAsyncCommand as a, type ICommandOf as b, RelayCommandBuilder as c, RelayCommandOf as d, RelayCommandOfBuilder as e };

// ==== testing.d.ts ====
import { Observable, SchedulerLike } from 'rxjs';
import { b as ITransactionalMessageHub, d as MessageHubOptions, I as IMessage, a as IMessageHub } from './messageHub.js';
import { I as IDispatcher, a as CollectionMutationAction, C as CollectionChangedMessage, P as PropertyChangedMessage, O as ObservableList, R as ReadOnlyObservableList, F as FormVM, c as FormVMOptions } from './formVm.js';
import { a as IAsyncCommand, I as ICommand, b as ICommandOf } from './relayCommand.js';

declare class RecordingMessageHub implements ITransactionalMessageHub {
    #private;
    constructor(options?: MessageHubOptions);
    get messages(): Observable<IMessage>;
    get records(): readonly IMessage[];
    send(message: IMessage): void;
    batch(transaction: () => void): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

declare class ManualDispatcher implements IDispatcher {
    #private;
    readonly foreground: SchedulerLike;
    readonly background: SchedulerLike;
    flushForeground(): void;
    flushBackground(): void;
    flushAll(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
interface TestServices {
    readonly hub: RecordingMessageHub;
    readonly dispatcher: IDispatcher;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function createTestServices(): TestServices;

interface PropertyChangeFilter<TSender> {
    readonly sender?: TSender;
    readonly propertyName?: string;
}
declare class PropertyChangeRecorder<TSender = unknown> {
    #private;
    constructor(hub: IMessageHub, filter?: PropertyChangeFilter<TSender>);
    get records(): readonly PropertyChangedMessage<TSender>[];
    get propertyNames(): readonly string[];
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function recordPropertyChanges<TSender = unknown>(hub: IMessageHub, filter?: PropertyChangeFilter<TSender>): PropertyChangeRecorder<TSender>;
interface CollectionChangeFilter {
    readonly sender?: object;
    readonly actions?: readonly CollectionMutationAction[];
}
declare class CollectionChangeRecorder<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(hub: IMessageHub, filter?: CollectionChangeFilter);
    get records(): readonly CollectionChangedMessage<T>[];
    get actions(): readonly CollectionMutationAction[];
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function recordCollectionChanges<T>(hub: IMessageHub, filter?: CollectionChangeFilter): CollectionChangeRecorder<T>;
type ObservableListMutationAction = CollectionMutationAction;
interface ObservableListChange<T> {
    readonly action: ObservableListMutationAction;
    readonly newItems: readonly T[];
    readonly oldItems: readonly T[];
    readonly newIndex: number;
    readonly oldIndex: number;
}
declare class ObservableListRecorder<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(list: ObservableList<T> | ReadOnlyObservableList<T>);
    get records(): readonly ObservableListChange<T>[];
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function recordObservableList<T>(list: ObservableList<T> | ReadOnlyObservableList<T>): ObservableListRecorder<T>;

interface CommandDoubleOptions {
    readonly canExecute?: boolean;
}
declare class CommandDouble implements ICommand {
    #private;
    constructor(options?: CommandDoubleOptions);
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    get executionCount(): number;
    canExecute(): boolean;
    execute(): void;
    setCanExecute(value: boolean): void;
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    failWith(error: Error | null): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare class CommandDoubleOf<T> implements ICommandOf<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(options?: CommandDoubleOptions);
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    get executions(): readonly T[];
    canExecute(_parameter: T): boolean;
    execute(parameter: T): void;
    setCanExecute(value: boolean): void;
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    failWith(error: Error | null): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare class AsyncCommandDouble implements IAsyncCommand {
    #private;
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    get errors(): Observable<unknown>;
    get executionCount(): number;
    get isExecuting(): boolean;
    canExecute(): boolean;
    execute(): void;
    executeAsync(externalSignal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;
    setCanExecute(value: boolean): void;
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    resolve(): void;
    reject(error: unknown): void;
    cancel(): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

type FormHarnessOptions<T> = Omit<FormVMOptions<T>, "persister" | "hub">;
declare class FormHarness<T> {
    #private;
    readonly hub: RecordingMessageHub;
    readonly form: FormVM<T>;
    readonly propertyChanges: PropertyChangeRecorder<FormVM<T>>;
    constructor(options: FormHarnessOptions<T>);
    get persistAttempts(): readonly T[];
    get approved(): readonly T[];
    get approveErrors(): readonly unknown[];
    set(value: T): void;
    approve(): Promise<void>;
    deny(): void;
    failNext(error: Error): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function createFormHarness<T>(options: FormHarnessOptions<T>): FormHarness<T>;

export { AsyncCommandDouble, type CollectionChangeFilter, CollectionChangeRecorder, CommandDouble, CommandDoubleOf, type CommandDoubleOptions, FormHarness, type FormHarnessOptions, ManualDispatcher, type ObservableListChange, type ObservableListMutationAction, ObservableListRecorder, type PropertyChangeFilter, PropertyChangeRecorder, RecordingMessageHub, type TestServices, createFormHarness, createTestServices, recordCollectionChanges, recordObservableList, recordPropertyChanges };
